stimulus_db: There can be no individual freedom without the rule of law, for there is no individual freedom without social integrity, and pursuing the good life is not possible without social integrity.
stem_db: The conclusion drawn above follows logically if which one of the following is assumed?

choices_db.A: There can be no rule of law without social integrity.
choices_db.B: There can be no social integrity without the rule of law.
choices_db.C: One cannot pursue the good life without the rule of law.
choices_db.D: Social integrity is possible only if individual freedom prevails.
choices_db.E: There can be no rule of law without individual freedom.
